```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample data
native_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana"],
    "spend": [500, 1200, 1000, 800]
})

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(native_df)

# Add tier column using conditional expression
df_with_tier = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then(nw.lit("gold")).otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Convert back to native pandas for display
result = nw.to_native(df_with_tier)
print(result)
```
